description: This file defines the main dashboard page component for a React-based frontend application. It manages state, fetches project data, metrics, and suggestions from an API, and renders various UI components including header, footer, metrics overview, charts, problems list, and suggestions panel.

methods.name: initialFilters
methods.description: Initializes and returns default filter settings for the dashboard.

methods.name: handleDocTypeChange
methods.description: Event handler to update the 'docType' filter when user changes the document type selection.

methods.name: handleSelectProject
methods.description: Handles project selection change, updates state, and triggers data reload.
